title.text:
DID THE EMPEROR
WALK OUT OF THE FIRE?
title.note: Chronicle Reveal v3.2b enter/exit unchanged; anchor = the K03 cut (Edward v3 rule: title carries across all opening cuts, clean 2 f before the next plate), so the hold runs f42-142 (lock 4.0 s -> 5.73 s). Both opening cuts land in the hold. fontSize 78: line 2 'WALK OUT OF THE FIRE?' 951 px (<= 994 px). K01 and K02 both keep 25-40 % calm for the band.

legend.note: small, quiet, upper-left (v2b keeps that corner calm + dark on K11); fades in 0.33-0.83 s after the cut with a 6 px rise, out 0.73-0.30 s before the next cut; no slam. Adjustable per plate in the build (--legend-pos x,y / --legend-size).

slots.vo: They buried a body as China's emperor.
slots.motion: WIDE: title lockup manifests; push 1.00->1.04 to the yellow-draped coffin; tall pole torches = glow pulse + spill on robes/coffin/faces (torch shapes static); faint smoke drifting off the torches; a few embers; cool night haze

slots.vo: His own uncle
slots.motion: WIDE: title holding; push 1.00->1.04 toward his face; single tall candle = flame-shape sway + flicker + warm spill across face/robe/map; warm haze + lit motes
slots.note: opening cut 2/3: cut in the 0.81 s pause, 0.08 s after 'emperor.' ends (2.252 s)

crop.note: placeholder: on his eyes (face at 42-55 % height); set on the real K02 plate

slots.vo: kept searching for him.
slots.motion: TIGHT: crop of the SAME K02 plate on his eyes (>= 70 % frame, else fallback); push 1.00->1.04; same fx seed + global clock as S02A (candle continues through the cut); title exits, clean 2 f before K03
slots.note: opening cut 3/3: cut on 'kept' (0.06 s gap -> word-start frame)

slots.vo: The missing emperor was Jianwen. His grandfather had founded the Ming dynasty.
slots.motion: slow drift founder->grandson; rows of candles on bronze stands = shape motion + grouped spill; warm haze, lit motes

slots.vo: But Jianwen inherited something else: uncles with armies.
slots.motion: slow push up to Zhu Di; sea of soldiers' torches = glow pulse + spill on armour (torch shapes static); smoke haze + a few embers

slots.vo: When he tried to take away their power, one uncle, Zhu Di, rebelled.
slots.motion: slow push from the fallen edict up to Zhu Di; brazier = BIG-FIRE glow pulse + spill (flame static) + embers; commanders' torches glow + spill

slots.vo: Three years later, Zhu Di reached Nanjing.
slots.motion: slow push toward the walls/gate; river of torches = glow pulse + spill on ranks/wall (static shapes); smoke haze; NO war SFX (not a battle)

slots.vo: A commander who had once fought for Jianwen helped open a city gate.
slots.motion: slow push past the general into the torchlit arch; torches pouring through the gate = glow pulse + spill on the gate leaves/paving; smoke haze

slots.vo: Then the palace caught fire. Zhu Di's men carried out a body.
slots.motion: slow push to the litter; burning roof = BIG FIRE (flame shapes static, glow + spill pulse) + dense embers + smoke above the roofline; soldiers' torches glow; wet-paving reflections STATIC (no water motion)

crop.note: placeholder: coffin (50-60 % height, centre) + Zhu Di at the grave head; set on the real K01 plate

slots.vo: He had it buried as his nephew.
slots.motion: K01 REPRISE, TIGHT crop on the coffin and Zhu Di at the grave head (different framing from the S01 wide); push 1.00->1.06; same K01 fx (pole torches glow/spill, faint smoke, embers)
slots.note: callback to the hook; flagged quick callback 2.33 s (owner 11:46: keep)

slots.vo: Jianwen's small son vanished too. Zhu Di
slots.motion: very slow push to the small shoes; single candle = shape motion + local spill on floor/bedding; dust motes
slots.note: runs through 'Zhu Di' (owner 11:46) so it holds 3.13 s

slots.vo: took the throne as Yongle, and wiped Jianwen's reign from the calendar.
slots.motion: v2b K10 = craftsmen chiselling the old calendar blocks: slow push to the chisel/block; bronze brazier = glow pulse + warm spill on craftsmen/blocks (flame/coal shape static) + a few embers; distant hall candles flicker; wood chips static
slots.note: owner 11:28: new K10; owner 11:46: cut on 'took' (0.07 s gap -> word-start frame), 'Zhu Di' stays on K09

slots.vo: But rumours said Jianwen had escaped, dressed as a monk.
slots.motion: COOL moon-blue: slow push following the figure; moonlit dreamlike mist drifting at the edges, cool ambience; small paper lantern = flicker + gentle sway + small local warm spill ONLY around the lantern; distant city = big-fire glow pulse on the horizon (static) + slow smoke; NO broad warm spill pumping; LEGEND label upper-left
slots.note: LEGEND label on this plate only

slots.vo: Yongle sent an official named Hu Ying across China.
slots.motion: slow push to the sealed orders between them; candle lamp-stand = shape motion + spill on both faces; warm haze

slots.vo: Officially, he was seeking a Daoist holy man. Secretly, he was looking for Jianwen.
slots.motion: WARM amber: slow push to Hu Ying's searching eyes; eave paper lanterns = amber flicker + gentle sway + warm spill on faces/gate posts; incense smoke curling from the burner

slots.vo: When Hu Ying's mother died, he asked to go home. Yongle refused.
slots.motion: slow push to his bowed face; single candle on the low table = shape motion + spill on face/letter; warm haze

slots.vo: More than twenty years after the fire, Hu Ying returned.
slots.motion: slow push to Hu Ying at the gate; guards' torches = glow pulse + spill (static shapes); dust haze, a few embers

slots.vo: Yongle was already in bed. He got up,
slots.motion: push in as he sits up; eunuch's oil lamp = flame-shape motion + spill across bed/face; warm haze

slots.vo: summoned the official, and listened until deep into the night.
slots.motion: very slow push between the two faces; single low candle = shape motion + strong local spill on both faces

slots.vo: The later History of Ming says Yongle's suspicions finally ended.
slots.motion: very slow push to Yongle's face; guttering candle stub = shape motion + flicker + spill; thin smoke curl off the wick

slots.vo: It never says what Hu Ying told him.
slots.motion: very slow push to the blank page; desk candle = shape motion + spill across page/desk; dust motes
slots.note: cut moved 0.21 s into the 0.67 s pause so S20 = 3.00 s

slots.vo: History remembers the victors. We remember the rest.
slots.motion: v2b Xuanfu outro, used AS-IS (no overlay text): the one lit window = warm flicker + glow; faint wall-walk torches = glow pulse (shape static); thin moonlit mist drifting; all kept OFF the baked lettering (30-70 % band); push 1.00->1.02 only if the lettering stays in frame; music fades

captions.text: They buried a body as China's emperor.
His grandfather had founded the Ming dynasty.
Zhu Di's men carried out a body.
He had it buried as his nephew.
Jianwen's small son vanished too. Zhu Di
and wiped Jianwen's reign from the calendar.
But rumours said Jianwen had escaped,
he was seeking a Daoist holy man.
Secretly, he was looking for Jianwen.
More than twenty years after the fire,
and listened until deep into the night.
